commands.name: screenshot
commands.description: Capture the Scene or Game view as a PNG and return its file path

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Output PNG path (absolute, or relative to the project root). Defaults to a timestamped file under <project>/Temp/pipeline-screenshots/.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Output width in pixels. 0 (default) uses the view camera's current width.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Output height in pixels. 0 (default) uses the view camera's current height.
